## Simplicity Audit

The row-by-row comparison found no remaining implementation mismatch:

- M3 uses `99.0`.
- M8 removes every measurability condition except the necessary positive-denominator guard.

M14b and R7 are genuinely equivalent. For floats, `[0,1]` rejects NaN and both infinities. Oversized integers bypass the float-only finite check in both versions and are rejected through exact integer comparison.

Write-free mutation probes produced intended assertion or domain-guard failures for M3, M8, M10, M13, M14, and M16; M14b and R7 remained green. All 36 mutated sources parse successfully, so no sampled kill was attributable to collection, import, anchor, or syntax failure.
